note: THE SOURCE MANIFEST. Every repository this site documents, the branch it is documented FROM, and
what may be read out of it. The generator reads nothing that is not declared here.
BRANCH SELECTION IS EXPLICIT AND PER-REPO, AND THAT IS NOT PEDANTRY. Measured 2026-08-01: the live
work in this estate is NOT on default branches. UNI-FLAGELLUM's main has 9 commits while the real
work on hierarchical-aif/motor-stack has 122. A pipeline that defaulted to 'main' would publish a
skeleton and call it the system. Every branch below was measured, not assumed.

exclude_reason: appendix-TA is Track-A: the commercial and delivery track (engagement, pricing, brand,
delivery-route ledger, commercial proof). It is the operator's own material and his own
published rate card, so it is not a leak — but it is BUSINESS content in a SCIENCE
encyclopedia, and this site documents the science. Excluded by scope, not by secrecy.
Recorded here rather than silently dropped, because the cookbook's own generator holds that
nothing may be omitted without saying so.

citation_policy.rule: Every citation records repo + branch + commit sha + path (+ line range where applicable).
consequence: PUBLISHED 2026-08-01. All three source repositories now have a public snapshot, so citations to
them resolve to real permalinks a reader can open. Citations into any source NOT listed above
(the math workbench) still render as UNRESOLVABLE and say so on their face, because a citation a
reader cannot open is an appeal to authority and the honest response is to mark it.
TWO COMMITS, AND THE DIFFERENCE MATTERS. A citation records the PRIVATE source commit the bytes
were ingested from — that is the provenance, and it is what the digest was taken over. The
permalink resolves against the PUBLIC SNAPSHOT commit, which is a single fresh commit holding the
same tree. They are different sha values naming the same content, and both are recorded here
rather than collapsed into one, because pretending a snapshot is the original commit would be a
THE SNAPSHOTS ARE NOT BYTE-IDENTICAL TO THE PRIVATE TREE, IN 17 PLACES. Third-party client
identifiers were replaced with '[redacted: client-identifier]' before publication — 12
occurrences in uni-minecraft, 5 in uni-flagellum-motor-stack, 0 in uni-cookbook. Those strings
name a client's organisation, personnel and internal tickets; they are not the author's to
publish. A citation landing on one of those files opens the redacted line, not the original.
Nothing else was removed from any snapshot.
